## Presentation

> Professor Marcel Costa directs this part of the **Design of innovative learning environments and initiation into educational research in the natural sciences** module called **from objectives to didactic sequences II**, to give relevance to the definition of learning objectives, the concept of didactic sequences, their programming and learning cycles.
